title: Learn Basic French Podcast
author: David Alexander Cantu
description: Bonjour! This is the perfect podcast if you're starting to learn French from the beginning. Every podcast episode is designed so that you can learn by listening. I use the highest quality French language and expressions taught by the Academy of the French language but I also add a bit of slang and everyday language and expressions. Subscribe and feel free to reach out!
